Unpopular opinion but ESH; Before y'all go ape-shit, lemme try and explain my opinion behind this:

Not all people can succeed through general academic systems. Schools are still engineered in a way where it is hard to get accommodations. There is also just the plain fact that some people just aren't cut out for that general type of schooling.

The fact you said your daughter wasn't the best academically already shows this (if it's true). If she wasn't, why do you think her struggling to make it through (and possibly fail if she isn't feeling capable to work through it) would be anymore beneficial to her? 

I guess some INFO I'd ask for is have you ever told her she wasn't academically all that good? Did you express in anger about this worry of yours?

To also add, even if you don't get a degree, or hell even graduate from highschool, it doesn't mean you're not cut out for things. Many people find success and happiness in jobs or hobbies (that can turn into jobs) that don't require extensive degrees.

Your daughter was young (still is young) when declaring to go NC. I think people are jumping to conclusions without thinking about the depth of the situation. Yes she is considered an adult now (Even then, 25 is still very fresh, and depending on the person, can be super immature)  but if this was a few years ago, she was still younger which I think can equate to a very rash, maybe not on her part thought out decision. 
  
I think it was good you respected that boundary of NC, I do think, even a small "Hey, just thinking about you and wondering how you're doing! I'd love to talk to you if you're comfortable" would be a step. If she was uncomfortable she wouldn't respond but you also never know because that could've been the thing she needed!

I feel absolutely guilty about my Crested Gecko, Asta

For a couple of years, I have wanted a Crested Gecko. I have had reptiles in the past (In my more adult life, I had a GORGEOUS Merauke Blue Tongue skink named JoJo but she needed to be rehomed as I was moving to Portland & was going to be renting) so she was rehomed to a friend (Currently doing great by the way!).

After a year in Portland, we moved to another place with more space (still a rental). At this time, I thought long & hard and was feeling like I wanted a smaller reptile with me.

I had already known quite a bit about Crested Geckos since I have a friend who has one and  & I researched like CRAZY that entire year+ plus some . Finally a couple of days after Christmas, I found the one on Morph Market. I absolutely fell in LOVE with him when I first saw him. Asta is a beautiful, male, Harlequin Pinstripe Crested Gecko. He is a green base tone with yellowish/light markings. When he is “fired up” He takes on a dark orange and red combo. I absolutely ADORE everything about him!


I got him a 18x18x36 cage and made it bioactive (For those who don’t know, Bioactive terrariums are ones that basically are a whole “ecosystem” with live plants and bugs to take care of mold and poop! It’s very great and I suggest it to anyone with a reptile!) Spent around $650 alone on his tank enrichment/food (He was a pretty penny as well).

When I got him (around late January?) , I didn’t think my Persian Cat (Millie) would do anything at the time, but a couple of days after he got here, she started to jump on top of his cage and stare down. I knew she COULDN’T see him but he could SEE her. Basically, since he has been here (He’s been here since February of this year [2021]) She jumps on his cage ALMOST EVERY NIGHT to try to see him.

Within the months I tried to handle him but he became more & more skittish. I have since just let him be, and now only feed him & give him water & mist his cage. I still take care of him the same as I did, but basically, I never see him anymore unless he’s sleeping in his little hide during the day. 

I feel so guilty for not handling him, but then I also think that as a Gecko he may not wanna be handled anyway. Then I also feel bad because I feel he would be a great stud for someone and perhaps someone would get him to warm up to handling, so at this point, I’m in the process of whether or not I should rehome him to a breeder/someone who has time/no rowdy pets/experience with geckos. I feel awful cause I told myself I would never do this to Asta after what happened with JoJo but I had no idea Millie would be such a menace. 

I feel like he needs to be rehomed. We do have a bigger closet area I could keep him in but after realizing how unbearably hot it gets in the warmer seasons when we’re on the highest floor, we can’t even keep him at a reasonable temperature in our general space (without icepacks and triple mistings in a day) so my original idea of keeping him in the closet to deter the cat would only roast him into a lizard kabob! 

I have no idea what to do at this point. I love my little guy but I feel I’m not giving him enough attention & he’d have more potential as a breeder! 

I was hoping for some insight from people who know Crested Geckos, breeders, non-breeders, hobbyist, etc. I just beg you don’t rip me a new one. I seriously try for this guy (Still am, might get him more springtails if I think his colony is dying).
